name: KHRONIKAS OF ARTUNA
source:
Khronikas of Artuna is an 18+ Furry Fantasy Visual novel about the slow adventure of Cirrus, Owen, and others in their ragtag group of friends. Join them in their pursuit of knowledge, wealth, magic, and many more in the Land of Artuna.

[From [url=https://starclock-studios.itch.io/khronikas-of-artuna]Itch.io[/url]]
